description: Public Go read API: cache successful responses using origin freshness
expression: http.host eq "api.mielenosoitukset.fi" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/home" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/cities" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/demonstrations" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/demonstrations/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/series/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/organizations/"))
